feeds.title: Yoga Trade Blog
feeds.description: Yoga Trade fosters connections between instructors, students, and wellness professionals worldwide, offering job and work trade opportunities. Their platform promotes community-building and positive action globally, enriching individuals and societies. Through resources and education, they support professional growth and inspire transformative experiences in yoga and wellness.

feeds.title: Pure Flow Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Read the Pure Flow Yoga blog about our intimate, affordable & unforgettable Yoga retreats, daily classes and more in an exotic magical jungle ocean paradise. Hi! I'm Francie, founder of the Pure Flow Yoga School. I am on a mission to uplift, educate, inspire and empower you to live an embodied, joyful, connected, purposeful, passionate, playful, fulfilled and awakened life in-service, on-purpose, and in-flow.

feeds.title: Exhale Yoga Retreats Blog
feeds.description: Exhale Yoga Retreats attracts positive people from around the globe that come together to unite a higher frequency of good vibes. Come join a fun loving crew and enjoy the company of new found friends in paradise for a life-enhancing experience.

feeds.title: Big Sky Yoga Retreats Blog
feeds.description: At Big Sky Yoga Retreats, we help big-hearted yoginis live out their dreams in beautiful Montana (and elsewhere) through yoga, horseback riding & more. Our mission is to take you on a journey deeper into yourself through yoga and outside activities. We believe everyone needs space to cultivate personal growth and physical health.

feeds.title: The Yogi Wanderer Blog
feeds.description: Travel guides and inspiration for the yoga obsessed. Read The Yogi Wanderer's blog for the best yoga friendly travel advice. My name is Vanda Mendonça and I'm a journalist turned yoga teacher turned travel blogger. Combining my passions for writing, traveling, and yoga, The Yogi Wanderer is a wellness travel website offering yoga-friendly travel advice for the mindful traveler.

feeds.title: Roam & Thrive
feeds.description: I'm Alex. Roam & Thrive is a female-centered travel blog made to inspire you to do just that. It's designed to feed your wanderlust while maintaining a healthy, active, and sustainable lifestyle. We aim to inspire and educate with unique curated guides and travel-focused wellness tips and workouts. Follow Roam & Thrive, the travel blog for everything wellness-focused travel. Find out how to travel the world healthily and sustainably.

feeds.title: The Yoga, Conscious Living and Travel Blog
feeds.description: International yoga teacher, author and travel advocate, Erica Boucher, enlightens and inspires on purposeful living, emotional intelligence, communication & relationships, yoga, conscious lifestyle, responsible travel and more.

feeds.title: Drishti Journeys Blog
feeds.description: Drishti Journeys has modernized the traditional yoga retreat by adding wellness and adventure components to their inspiring journeys. Keep up with the latest news in travel, yoga, wellness and more. Designed to deepen your yoga practice, experience cultural immersion and indulge in local cuisines, our mindful journeys allow us to hit the pause button and apply self-care and realization for the active yogi and explorer.

feeds.title: Boreal Bliss Yoga Retreats Blog

We create inclusive space for yoga enthusiasts to retreat into the wilderness of Northern Minnesota.

feeds.description: Hi We are Stephen & Jane. We're adventure-seekers and full-time yoga nomads. For almost two years, we travelled the world by bicycle, cycling through 22 countries in Europe and Asia. We started blogging about our bike touring adventures and also how to help you travel more mindfully and make travel more fulfilling for you.

feeds.title: Blue Osa

Our yoga and travel blog is full of advice on combining the two into the ingredients for a life-changing journey.
